# Urip Yoga Pangestu — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Urip Yoga Pangestu, Information Systems student at Telkom University Purwokerto. Fullstack web developer specializing in Laravel, Django, React.js, and modern web technologies.

## About
Urip Yoga Pangestu is an Information Systems student and fullstack web developer based in Purwokerto, Indonesia. BNSP Certified Web Developer and Google AI Professional & Cybersecurity certified via Coursera. Passionate about building performant, accessible web applications.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 18, React Router, Tailwind CSS 4, Vite
- Backend: Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage)
- Hosting: Vercel + Cloudflare
